description:
I'm Elias Mercer — and everything I know about survival, I learned the hard way, alone, off the grid, where a single mistake can cost you everything.

This channel is where I hand down the old frontier knowledge most people forgot on purpose. The skills your great-grandfather lived by before bills and store shelves made folks helpless. How to start fire when everything's wet. How to build shelter that beats a blizzard. What's safe to eat out here — and what'll kill you slow. The tricks that make modern survival gear look like a joke.

No fluff. No theory. Just hard-won frontier skills from a man who actually lives them.

Subscribe — and learn the old ways before they're gone for good.
